config.name: AMSR2 independent-instrument matched observation verification
config.product: RSS GCOM-W1 AMSR2 daily AS-ECV v8.2
config.quality_rule: finite SST in [-3,35] degrees Celsius; time in [0,24) hours UTC; land/coast/sea_ice/noobs masks all zero; exact common grid; fixed 2010 ocean mask
config.spatial_transfer: grid forecast = OISST grid observation at origin d-h + frozen regional forecast(d) - regional OISST observation at origin d-h; no fitted spatial coefficient; same transfer applied to frozen anomaly-persistence baseline; raw grid persistence also scored
config.score_weighting: cosine-latitude weighted loss across common observed cells within each target UTC day, then equal weight per day; no spatial pseudo-replication
config.scope: Independent instrument observations, not a fully statistically independent product: RSS v8.2 instrument drift characterization used Reynolds SST. Prior OISST 2026 scores already viewed; this external-observation protocol is frozen before viewing AMSR2 2026 targets. Retrospective forecasts with fixed spatial projection; evaluates observed offshore grid cells, not unobserved coast or full-domain means. No retuning, bias correction, or interval recalibration. Regional interval radii at grid cells are diagnostic only.

interpretation: Independent instrument observations, not a fully statistically independent product: RSS v8.2 instrument drift characterization used Reynolds SST. Prior OISST 2026 scores already viewed; this external-observation protocol is frozen before viewing AMSR2 2026 targets. Retrospective forecasts with fixed spatial projection; evaluates observed offshore grid cells, not unobserved coast or full-domain means. No retuning, bias correction, or interval recalibration. Regional interval radii at grid cells are diagnostic only.
implementation_notes: Initial scoring execution stopped before producing results because regional origins ended in 2025. The repair appends 2026 origin observations already retained in the SHA-locked prediction CSV, reads only d-h, and changes no frozen rule or model.
